Summary: 10 requirements reviewed: 10 with issues, 0 without. 10 issues found (8 Medium, 2 Low). Types: Vague_Language (2), Incomplete_Requirement (6), Ambiguous_Statement (2).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for every online banking session.
REQ-002: The system shall complete 95% of fund transfers within 3 seconds under a load of 1,000 concurrent users.
REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate fund transfers when a user retries a request due to a network timeout.
REQ-004: For every successful fund transfer, the system shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
REQ-006: Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
REQ-008: The system shall reject a fund transfer if the source account has insufficient available balance at the time of transfer execution.
REQ-009: The system shall notify the customer through email or SMS within 60 seconds after a successful fund transfer.
REQ-010: The system shall support fund transfers of up to INR 500,000 per transaction.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for every online banking session.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'online banking session' has no objective definition in the document, so the scope is unclear.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what constitutes an online banking session for authentication purposes.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall complete 95% of fund transfers within 3 seconds under a load of 1,000 concurrent users.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The document does not specify the measurement conditions for 'complete' or the type of fund transfers being measured.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what 'complete' means and specify the type of fund transfers for the performance metric.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall prevent duplicate fund transfers when a user retries a request due to a network timeout.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: It is unclear whether the retry is initiated by the user or the system, and what constitutes a network timeout.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify who initiates the retry and the definition of a network timeout.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: For every successful fund transfer, the system shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the conditions under which the debits and credits are considered successful or the account types involved.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what constitutes a successful fund transfer and the account types for debits and credits.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The document does not specify the scope of the regional outage or the definition of 'recovery' in this context.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the scope of the regional outage and what 'recovery' means for the system.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the type of transaction audit records or the protection mechanisms required.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify the type of transaction audit records and the required protection mechanisms.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'application components' has no objective definition in the document, so the scope is unclear.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what constitutes application components for encryption purposes.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall reject a fund transfer if the source account has insufficient available balance at the time of transfer execution.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify what 'available balance' means or the conditions under which it is checked.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the definition of available balance and the conditions for checking it.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall notify the customer through email or SMS within 60 seconds after a successful fund transfer.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: It is unclear whether the notification is sent to the customer or the system, and what constitutes a successful fund transfer.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify who receives the notification and the definition of a successful fund transfer.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The system shall support fund transfers of up to INR 500,000 per transaction.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the currency or the type of fund transfers supported.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify the currency and the type of fund transfers for the transaction limit.
